Several [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] clans engaged the [[Ithullan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in a '''war''' over a [[Mandallian Narcolethe/Legends|narcolethe]] distillery in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]]. After claiming victory over their foes, members of [[Aka'liit]] took the fight to [[Ithull]] itself. After seizing the planet's orbital stations, the Mandalorians blacked out planetary communications and deactivated their power-beam arrays. The now helpless darkened cloudtop cities were then raided by the Mandalorians, splitting their reactor bulbs and plunging the cities into the fathomless [[Ithullan Depths]], resulting in the near-[[Speciecide|extinction]] of the Ithullan race; which a number of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Historical Council|scholars]] viewed as the most heinous crime of its era.

Because the Jedi Council did nothing in response to the genocide, a group of rogue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], in retaliation, allied<ref name="NEC" /> with the [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Durge/Legends|Durge]]<ref name="Durge">{{DB|character|durge|Durge}}</ref> against the orders of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], and [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] the ruling [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']], leader of the Mandalorian clans,<ref name="NEC" /> nearly a hundred years later.<ref name="Durge" />

The genocide of the Ithullan species<ref name="NEC" /> led to a large number of Mandalorian soldiers growing dissatisfied with their out-of-control, immoral contemporaries. This desire for change was taken to heart by [[Jaster Mereel]], who instituted a new standard of behavior for the Mandalorian warrior clans when he rose to the position of ''Mand'alor''<ref name="HotM">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref> in [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]]. Mereel [[Author/Legends|authored]] the [[Supercommando Codex]],<ref name="NEC" /> a new standard for Mandalorian ethics, which stated that any Mandalorian who wished to fight were to conduct themselves as honorable [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]].<ref name="Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons">''[[Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons]]''</ref>
